correctness.rationale: For iid Gaussian interactions and fixed finite N, the pure-ESS inequalities give the exact conditional Gaussian integral. Independent row maxima yield the binomial zero-ratio law. Stein integration by parts proves strict mean decrease for N>=3. A conditional shrinking Gaussian interval and its N(0,4) positive-part expectation yield the pair constant; independent pair contrasts bound triple ESS events by O_N(mu^-2). Finite inclusion-exclusion proves the complete zero/one/multiple asymptotics. Twelve reproducible finite numerical checks passed; experiments are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: Monomorphic ESS multiplicity measures alternative invasion-resistant single-strain endpoints in the motivating ecological ensemble. The exact zero-ratio law and first inverse-ratio finite-co-colonization correction identify the rate and coefficient at which distinct monomorphic endpoints vanish, unlike only knowing the antisymmetric limit or a numerical trend. Explicit N dependence supplies meaningful simulation benchmarks. No claim about all-support ESSs or general biological outcomes.
